description: AWS infrastructure-as-code guidance from an MCP client: search Terraform Registry provider and Cloud Control docs, list provider resources, search and inspect modules, read the latest provider version, search user guides, run a deterministic policy scan over a terraform plan JSON, and get plain-language explanations of common AWS resource types. A clean-room, renamed rebuild of the aws-terraform MCP server's core surface. One bin serves the CLI and a stdio MCP server.
name: @reneturcios/cloudinfra
